## What you're trying to do

The actual workflow or outcome you're after — not a proposed solution, but the underlying need. e.g. "I want to catch citations where the parser swapped the author and title fields."

## Why the current behavior falls short

What you've already tried with the existing audit rules / workflow, and why it didn't get you all the way.

## What you'd like instead

If you have a specific feature in mind — a new audit rule, a UI affordance, an export format, a bulk-action shortcut, an API endpoint — describe it. Don't worry about implementation details; the rough shape is enough.

## Example data (if relevant)

If the feature is about catching a particular pattern in deposit XML, include an example citation that demonstrates the pattern. The clearer the bad-case example, the easier it is to encode a rule.

```xml
<!-- paste an example citation if applicable -->
```

## Priority for you

Just a sense of how much this matters in your workflow. "Would be nice" / "Blocking me from depositing" / "Recurring annoyance" — anything that helps me triage.

## Anything else

Related Crossref documentation, similar features in other tools, papers you've seen on the topic — whatever context you think helps.
